changelog: Renamed the visible product name to CSM everywhere: settings entry and page titles, bottom sheet, notifications and update prompts, Discord Rich Presence activity name, download/subtitle labels, loading overlay, toasts, feature status reports and the repository listing in Extensions.

Only display text changed. Internal identity is untouched, so updates, saved settings and stored data keep working: preference keys and values, class and file names, the plugin internal name (CS3MProvider), the packaged manifest name and the repository URL all stay the same.
Settings exports from older versions still import unchanged; the export field is informational and is not used for validation.
The settings-entry auto-open scanner matches the new CSM label and the older spelling, so upgraded and legacy hosts both keep working.
